summary: Walked every route in App.js as president, division-secretary and secretary. Focus pages (Tournaments, Players, Grant Claims, Members/Org, Discussions) were deep-dived tab-by-tab. The core finding is not a broken platform — most flows load, data renders, personas are honoured — but a **severe surface-area problem**: too many financial / claims / registry pages that overlap, several dashboards showing 100-300+ buttons or 100+ inputs on a single screen, and a handful of legitimate 'coming soon / not-yet' surfaces. Discussion, Grant Claims two-pane, and /showcase already look production-grade. The /design-preview HUDs are the north star. Player Register, Rate Cards, Audit Log, /org, Tournament Registry and Player Registrations are the P0 redesign candidates.

tournaments_list.division_secretary_sees: 1 tournament (Parmanand Trophy TRN-2026-27-086) — Indore Division 'Pre-Tournament Camp' is NOT visible as a top-level tourn row for div-sec
tournaments_list.symptom_short: Persona scope may be hiding Indore pre-camp, and 20 buttons on list is fine but there are no filters/search visible.

tournament_detail.symptom_short: Only 2 sub-tabs visible (OVERVIEW / SQUAD SELECTION). The 10-step lifecycle (Tournament Creation → Pool Basics → Match Official Posting → Squad → Squad Approval → Match Calendar → Unified Budget → Finance Console → Tournament Closure → MPCA Visibility) is rendered ONLY as a visual stepper — not clickable. A 45+ admin cannot discover budget/finance/closure surfaces from here.
tournament_detail.symptom_detail: Everything except Overview and Squad Selection is either inline (scroll to find), gated behind lifecycle state, or reachable ONLY from side nav (/tournament-finance, /tournament-budgets, /reimbursement-claims). Request called for tabs 'basics, participants matrix, match officials, squads, match calendar, days engine, unified budget, finance console, closure letter, activity log, discussion, pre-camps' — most exist as separate routes but are NOT surfaced on the tournament detail page.

grant_claims.symptom_short: Two-pane list + detail with 4 tabs (Details, Documents (0), Discussion (4), History). Clean, coherent, works. AI Review badge and Summary PDF button are surfaced well. AttachedCampView loads via 'attached-camp-invoice-table'.
grant_claims.symptom_detail: GRC-2026-27-0009 loads with lifecycle stepper (Draft → Submitted → Under MPCA Review → Approved → Payment Made). Discussion tab shows 4 messages inline with clean bubble UI. This is the model the rest of the app should be redesigned toward.

player_register_list.symptom_short: 329 buttons on a single page. Filter chips work (All/Active/Pending/In Review/Discrepancy/Div-Approved/Suspended/Local-MP/Born-Outside/Guest/Court Orders — 11 chips), plus 4 stat cards, plus 3 category cards, plus per-row status/action buttons. Cognitive overload for 45+ admin.
player_register_list.symptom_detail: Very information-dense. Two 'ALL' buttons (All-in-scope + All body-type) can confuse. Search field is at the bottom of a long chip row — should be primary. Recompute-eligibility button is orange-outlined next to primary orange 'Register a Player' — competing CTAs.

player_detail.symptom_short: 6 tabs (Overview, Performance, Eligible Tournaments, KYC & Documents, Sanctions, Audit Trail). Structure is fine; Overview is empty for the TEST_Transfer sample (0-state 'Not yet computed — click Recompute').
player_detail.symptom_detail: KYC & Documents tab has 22 inputs — inline upload widgets. Eligible Tournaments shows 70 rows for this player = long scroll. Sanctions tab has a clean empty state.

membership_register.symptom_short: 8 members. Filter row (All/MPCA/Division + All/Individual/Institutional/Honorary/Patron) is clean and the table layout is well-spaced.

organisational_structure.symptom_short: 70 buttons on a single page. BCCI → MPCA → Divisions → Districts tree is displayed with 10 divisions and 54 districts inline — every row has an OPEN button. Scannable but noisy.
organisational_structure.symptom_detail: Expanding the whole tree by default produces a very long page. A collapsed-by-default tree with a search jump would be friendlier for 45+ users.

discussions.symptom_short: Two-pane conversation list + thread. Chat bubbles are readable, timestamps and body-scope are shown. Compose box has helper text 'Use @ to tag someone. Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to post.'
discussions.symptom_detail: Best-in-class page in the ERP right now — the pattern to preserve.

orphan_routes_no_nav_entry: /grant-claims/:id/summary (PDF viewers, reachable via detail-page CTAs — OK)
public_routes_that_should_be_gated: /showcase (intentional — data-input personas write, showcase is public read)
buttons_that_do_nothing_or_dead_ends: Player list has an 11-chip filter row + two 'ALL' buttons stacked — potentially competing states.
/tournaments detail: 'Tournament Progression' visual stepper items (Tournament Creation, Pool Basics, Match Official Posting, etc.) look clickable but are not tabs — visual illusion.
/action-center 'Complete squad · DIV-IND (0/15)' pill on Parmanand Trophy — appears clickable but doesn't advertise its target.
personas_who_see_broken_or_empty_pages: division-secretary sees a heavy left nav (18 links) but Tournaments list shows only Parmanand — no Indore Pre-Tournament Camp row despite Grant Claim GRC-2026-27-0009 explicitly referencing 'Indore Division · Pre-Tournament Camp'. Suggests the pre-camp is a child of Parmanand and not surfaced independently.
public / unauthenticated users can freely browse /design-preview and /design-lab — leaks unshipped design scratchpad.

p0_redesign_needed_45plus_admin.reason: 329 buttons, 11 chips, 4 stat cards, 3 category cards, competing CTAs
129 inputs on a single scroll — inline-edit hell
124 buttons, 7 actions per row, TEST_ data mixed with real
10-stage lifecycle rendered as passive stepper — no navigation into stages
201 rows dumped at once, no visible pagination
Four claim surfaces confuse the single mental model 'file a claim'
Four finance surfaces confuse 'see the money'

design_issues_general: Serif big-headline pattern is elegant but section eyebrows (small orange caps like 'ARTICLE V · THE REGISTER') can be missed by 45+ users — too small.
Multiple pages use a season selector at top-right AND tournament-scoped season inside the page — potential state confusion.
Left-nav is 18–21 items long depending on persona; grouping headings (SECRETARIAL / FINANCIAL / OPERATIONS / GOVERNANCE) help, but scroll is required.
Numbers like ₹41,08,580 use Indian formatting consistently — good. But some stat tiles show plain digits (312, 289) without a scale label.
notable_positives: Persona chip login is fast and clear.
Grant Claims two-pane + 4-tab layout is production-grade.
Discussion module is clean and friendly.
/showcase and /design-preview HUDs prove the design bar the rest of the app can reach.
Every interactive element has data-testid — testability is excellent.
Season selector shows fiscal cycles 2023-24 through 2029-30 — data model is future-proofed.

phase_2_cleave_plan_suggested_order: 1. DELETE: /design-lab (public typography sampler). MOVE /design-preview under an auth or fold into /showcase.
2. MERGE claim surfaces: fold /claims + /division-grants + /reimbursement-claims into /grant-claims with type filter chips.
3. MERGE finance surfaces: keep /budgets as the master (with tournament & body views as tabs); redirect /tournament-finance, /tournament-budgets, /budget-vs-actual → /budgets?view=X.
4. FIX /tournaments/:id — turn the 10-stage lifecycle stepper into a real tabbed navigator so admins can click Match Calendar, Unified Budget, Finance Console, Closure, Discussion inline.
5. FIX /players — collapse 11 chips into 3 primary + 'More filters'. Promote search to the top. Kill 'Recompute eligibility (all)' as a competing primary button (move to overflow menu).
6. FIX /rate-cards — replace 129-input scroll with a per-head editor drawer (click row → open drawer → edit rate → save).
7. FIX /audit-log — add pagination or virtual scroll; add module + actor + date-range filter chips at top.
8. FIX /player-registrations — delete TEST_ campaigns from prod seed; group 7 per-row actions into a kebab menu.
9. FIX /org — collapse tree by default; add search-jump-to-body.
10. Consolidate calendars: merge /tournament-calendar into /events with a 'type' filter.
recommendations_for_main_agent.estimated_route_count_after_cleave: ≈ 30 routes (down from 52 visited), aligned to a 2-layer arch: main platform (input) + /showcase (read-only).
